capabilities: Turn note Markdown into spaced-repetition cards
Schedule reviews with FSRS-6 or FSRS-7, learning steps and daily limits
Study with image occlusion, multiple choice, typed answers and read-aloud
Run timed exams with a question map, score and results
Generate cards with an AI provider and import or export Anki decks
extras: AI card generation needs Obsidian 1.13.1 or later; the key is kept in Obsidian's secret storage and a local server needs none. Network requests happen only for the optional update check and the AI features, which are off by default. Cards, schedules, review logs and exams are stored as plain files in the vault.
intentEvidence: reads and writes the same note format as the Spaced Repetition plugin
problem: Notes hold facts worth memorizing, but Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule repeated reviews of them over time.

relations.evidence: reads and writes the same note format as the Spaced Repetition plugin
Import .apkg and text files with their media and decks, and export back to Anki.

requires.name: AI provider API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, OpenRouter or a local server)

summary: Flashcard plugin that turns note Markdown into spaced-repetition cards with FSRS scheduling, image occlusion, timed exams and AI card generation.
